feeds.title: Emen8
feeds.description: Emen8 is Australia's biggest and boldest online sexual health and well-being initiative for gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men! Our online presence includes Emen8.com.au and Facebook. Emen8 is designed to be a force for good, providing reliable, informative content that keeps you up to date on all matters related to sexual health and well-being.

feeds.title: Sex Ed Rescue Blog
feeds.description: Sex Ed Rescue Blog covers book reviews on different topics of Sex Education like Sex and Emotional Safety, Periods, Reproductive systems, and more. Sex Ed Rescue helps parents to talk to their kids about sex with less cringe and more confidence so they can empower their children to make smart sexual decisions.

feeds.title: Clinic 66 Blog
feeds.description: Here at Clinic 66, we pride ourselves on our professional, compassionate, caring, discreet, and 100% non-judgmental approach. We understand that some people find dealing with their sexual health concerns confronting. But we can comfortably say, that when it comes to sexual health issues, there's nothing we haven't seen before. Our blog aims to break down these barriers and our articles cover the tough topics that we generally just don't talk about.

feeds.title: Caddyshack Project Blog » Sexual Health
feeds.description: Caddyshack Project is a sexual health program that promotes a positive approach to sex and sexuality for young people and the broader community. Find Informative and inclusive sex-positive content featuring what you need to know about sexually transmissible infections, safe sex including contraception and protection, sexual consent, and many more. We promise it is not all about sex, but it is all about life and relationships with yourself and others. A positive approach to sex and sexual health in the sexual health section.

feeds.title: Sex Life Therapy Blog
feeds.description: The intent of Sex Life Therapy is to create a comfortable working environment where they can collaborate toward your goals. Dr. Christopher Fox and the team at Sex Life Therapy provide confidential and individualized sex therapy and relationship therapy to individuals and couples. He regularly publishes informative blogs and educational articles on the site.

feeds.title: ASHM
feeds.description: ASHM is a peak organization of health professionals in Australia and New Zealand who work in HIV, viral hepatitis, other BBVs, and sexually transmissible infections. ASHM draws on its experience and expertise to support the health workforce and to contribute to the sector, domestically and internationally. Our vision is the virtual elimination of HIV, viral hepatitis, and other BBVs and a significant reduction of sexually transmissible infections.
